m01:room.title: The Wheel Timing Shop
m01:room.job: Measure the big wheel's speed two ways, and see if they agree.

m02:room.title: The Ship Load Room
m02:room.job: Work out how hard the Narwhal's arm pushes at the bottom of the swing.

m03:room.title: The Carousel Drive House
m03:room.job: Find the circle a hanging chair rides, and the speed its lean allows.

m04:room.title: The Impact Test Bay
m04:room.job: Find the energy a bumper car brings in, and the floor's push that stops it.

m05:room.title: The Brennan Metrology Room
m05:room.job: Find how far off the park's speed wheel reads.

m06:room.title: The Independent Timing Annex
m06:room.job: Compare the shared wheel with light gates that keep their own time.

m07:room.title: The Impulse Review Room
m07:room.job: Measure the brake's push on the Narwhal, and the change in its motion.

m08:room.title: The Period Trace Cabin
m08:room.job: Compare the motor's pushes with the Narwhal's own swing.

m09:room.title: The Arm Inspection Loft
m09:room.job: Find how hard a gust twists the root pin of arm nine.

m10:room.title: The Loop Dynamics Office
m10:room.job: Work out the speeds the coaster needs at the top of its loop.

m11:room.title: The Flume Hydraulic Lab
m11:room.job: Find the water's speed in the narrow pipe, and the power the pump draws.

m12:room.title: The Tower Witness Cabin
m12:room.job: Find how fast the drop car hits the brake fins, and how hard they stop it.

m13:room.title: The Capacity Schedule Office
m13:room.job: Add up the rides that run together, and find what the power plant has left.

m14:room.title: The Geometry Verification Room
m14:room.job: Use the crown radius measured on the real track to work out the speeds again.

m15:room.title: The Park Evidence Board
m15:room.job: Work out the last two numbers the park's safety certificate needs.
